mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND selected = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND selected = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM cart_items WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_items, COUNT(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN 1 END) as selected_items, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as selected_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) as selected_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(ci.id) as item_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, COUNT(ci.id) as cart_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.image ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) as selected_items, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as selected_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as selected_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND selected = 1

SELECT CASE WHEN product_price < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN '200-500' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as price_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY CASE price_range WHEN '0-50' THEN 1 WHEN '50-100' THEN 2 WHEN '100-200' THEN 3 WHEN '200-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(ci.id) as item_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.brand as brand_name, COUNT(ci.id) as item_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL AND p.brand != '' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.sku as sku, p.name as product_name, COUNT(ci.id) as cart_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 GROUP BY p.sku, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.image as product_image, COUNT(ci.id) as cart_count, SUM(ci.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(ci.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.status = 1 AND p.image IS NOT NULL AND p.image != '' GROUP BY p.image ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status
SELECT selected, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY selected

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(updated_at) as date, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY DATE(updated_at) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN product_price < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN '200-500' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as price_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY CASE price_range WHEN '0-50' THEN 1 WHEN '50-100' THEN 2 WHEN '100-200' THEN 3 WHEN '200-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT CASE WHEN quantity = 1 THEN '1' WHEN quantity = 2 THEN '2' WHEN quantity = 3 THEN '3' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4-5' ELSE '6+' END as quantity_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY quantity_range ORDER BY CASE quantity_range WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4-5' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT CASE WHEN subtotal < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN subtotal BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN subtotal BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN subtotal BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN '200-500' WHEN subtotal BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as subtotal_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY subtotal_range ORDER BY CASE subtotal_range WHEN '0-50' THEN 1 WHEN '50-100' THEN 2 WHEN '100-200' THEN 3 WHEN '200-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN 1 END) as selected_items, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as selected_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN selected = 1 THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) as selected_amount, COALESCE(AVG(product_price), 0) as average_price, COALESCE(MIN(product_price), 0) as min_price, COALESCE(MAX(product_price), 0) as max_price, COALESCE(AVG(quantity), 0) as average_quantity, COALESCE(AVG(subtotal), 0) as average_subtotal FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
